verdict.rationale: The skill is distributed as an open Agent Skills folder that you copy into your own personal or project skills directory. It works in any agent that supports skills, and it can be packaged locally with tools/package_skill.py. Its dependency-free Python tools and local SVG gallery also run on the user's own machine. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, documentation of running end-to-end with a self-hosted model or agent, and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted setup.
